parameters.question: Each residue is replaced by a RANDOMLY chosen member of its conservative functional group, so redesigned_sequence will legitimately differ from the reference letter-by-letter. Do not require string equality of redesigned_sequence. For each row verify: (1) original_sequence (and its ID) matches the reference; (2) redesigned_sequence has exactly the same length as original_sequence; (3) every position of redesigned_sequence is an amino acid from the same conservative group as the corresponding original residue, using groups: aliphatic (G,A,V,L,I), aromatic (F,Y,W), positive (K,R,H), negative (D,E), polar uncharged (S,T), sulfur-containing (C,M), polar amide (N,Q), proline (P). Column order may differ. Judge compliance with these rules, not identity of the random draws.
